notes.title: Patch notes 4/29/25
notes.notes:
A new patch is up for [i]No More Heroes 2: Desperate Struggle[/i]. Here's what's new: 

- Keys assigned to High/Low Beat Attack on keyboard can now be used to shoot in "Bizarre Jelly 5" mini-game.
- Fixed another situation in Side Job 08 "Stings So Good" where the player's controls could become locked.
- Fixed a crash that could occur at the end of some Side Jobs.
- Fixed an uncommon situation where the achievement "It was a Desperate Struggle" could fail to unlock.
- Fixed a crash caused by enabling MSAA on certain graphics cards.
- Slightly improved performance and quality when FXAA is enabled.
- Improved compatibility with variable refresh rate displays.
- Other minor performance optimizations and stability fixes.

If you encounter any issues with [i]No More Heroes 2[/i], please email support@xseedgames.com with details.

notes.title: Patch notes 4/7/25
notes.notes:
A new patch is up for [i]No More Heroes 2[/i]. Here's what's new: 

- Full keyboard and mouse support has been added. 
- Gamepad rebinding is now supported. 
- Default controls have been updated for most minigames. 
- The game is now compatible with Steam’s Offline Mode. 
- The following achievements now unlock properly: “Desperate Massacre”, “Minigame Masteroo” and “Maybe See a Doctor?”  
- Text prompts and notifications from interactable objects now appear consistently.  
- General stability fixes and minor Quality of Life improvements. 

Thank you for your patience while we continued to address the issues and feedback shared with us. We apologize for the wait, and thank you for your continued support. 

If you encounter any issues with [i]No More Heroes 2[/i], please email support@xseedgames.com with details.

notes.title: Patch notes 7/14/21
notes.notes:
A new patch is up for No More Heroes 2: Desperate Struggle! Here's what's new: 
- Fixed issue where the game would not start properly or not recognize save games correctly if your user directory had an accented character in it.
- Fixed issue where the game would not run on certain Windows 8.1 configurations.
- Fixed issue where the button controls for Muscle Training at Ryan's Gym would not be listed correctly.

Thank you for your patience as we work towards solutions for other issues! If you are experiencing an issue with No More Heroes 2: Desperate Struggle, please email support@xseedgames.com with details.
